set_process_kaons

set_process_kaons(self: am3.AM3, arg0: bool) -> None

Master switch for kaons (am3_mojo addition): K+-, K0_S and K0_L from photo-hadronic interactions of
protons and neutrons and from pp collisions, their escape, cooling (synchrotron and inverse Compton for K+-)
and decay, and the decay products (pions, muons, e+-, neutrinos). Needs the photo-pion or the pp process
with its emission. With kaons on, the pion yields of the photo-hadronic multi-pion types are reduced by the
kaons' energy, and in pp collisions the protons also lose the kaons' energy. The kaons of charm decays come with the
charm hadrons (set_process_charm), whatever this switch.
Set to False (no kaons, as in AM3) / True. Default: True.

set_process_charm

set_process_charm(self: am3.AM3, arg0: bool) -> None

Master switch for charm hadrons (am3_mojo addition): D+-, D0, anti-D0, Ds+-, Lambda_c+ and
anti-Lambda_c- from photo-hadronic interactions of protons and neutrons and from pp collisions, their
escape, cooling (synchrotron and inverse Compton for the charged ones) and decay, and the decay products
(kaons, pions, muons, e+-, nucleons, photons, neutrinos and tau neutrinos). Needs the photo-pion or the pp
process with its emission. With charm on, the pion yields of the photo-hadronic multi-pion types are
reduced by the charm hadrons' energy, and in pp collisions the protons also lose it.
Set to False (no charm hadrons, as in AM3) / True. Default: True.

set_process_charm_decay

set_process_charm_decay(self: am3.AM3, arg0: bool) -> None

Switch for charm decay (am3_mojo addition): every mode of D+-, D0, anti-D0, Ds+-, Lambda_c+ and
anti-Lambda_c- with a branching ratio above 0.5 % and every exclusive semileptonic mode above 0.1 %
(PDG 2026); their short-lived products (tau, eta, eta', omega, phi, rho, K*, f0, a1, hyperons) decay at
once.
Set to False (charm hadrons do not decay) / True. Default: True.
